半山腰密林，杀气翻涌。

三名甲贺上忍舍弃合围阵型，周身邪力暴涨，黑衣衣摆无风自动，手中淬毒短刃泛着幽绿冷光，带着一往无前的凌厉杀机，从三个方位同时朝着胡九郎猛扑而来。

三人皆是甲贺流派顶尖高手，精通忍术、遁术、毒功、近身搏杀，联手一击，足以撕裂寻常修士的护身结界，威势骇人。

林间风声骤停，空气仿佛被杀气冻结，其余忍者纷纷后撤，腾出战场空间，静待三名上忍斩杀对手领头之人。

“胡师兄小心！”范梦雪眸光一凝，就要催动雷法上前支援。

“不必。”胡九郎抬手示意她留守阵型，独自一人直面三名上忍，身影孤挺如松，立于八卦阵纹中央。

他左手负于身后，右手指尖捏定镇煞印诀，周身金色卦纹流转环绕，先天八卦之力蓄势待发。

三道黑影转瞬逼近，短刃带着破空锐风，分别劈向胡九郎眉心、心口、腰侧三处要害，招式狠辣刁钻，招招致命。

就在短刃即将近身的刹那——

地面八卦阵纹骤然金光暴涨，化作一道圆形金色结界，将胡九郎周身牢牢护住。

铛！铛！铛！

三声刺耳金铁交鸣接连响起。

三名上忍的淬毒短刃狠狠劈在金光结界之上，气浪翻滚，尘土扬起，却根本破不开八卦结界的防御，反倒被震得手臂发麻，身形不由自主往后退了数步。

三人眼底皆是震惊。

没想到这名年轻道士的阵法修为竟强悍到这种地步，仅凭结界便硬生生扛下三人联手强攻，纹丝不动。

“强攻不破，改用诡术！”

一名上忍低喝一声，三人身形骤然分化，化作无数分身幻影，真假难辨，借着残影迷惑视线，再度从四面八方突袭，专攻结界破绽。

“雕虫小技。”

胡九郎眸色清冷，天眼直视之下，所有分身幻影无所遁形，三人本体气息清晰映入眼底。

他指尖轻轻一捻，凌空悬浮的三张朱砂符箓瞬间燃起火光，化作三道赤红光带，精准锁定三名上忍本体，无视分身干扰，直袭眉心。

Chapter 87: The Three Ninjas are Headed and the Ancient Temple Relics - "749 Game of the Taoist Priest Descending the Mountain"

The dense forest halfway up the mountain was filled with murderous aura.

The three Koga jounin gave up their encirclement formation, and the evil power around them surged. The hems of their black clothes moved automatically without wind, and the poison-quenched short blades in their hands glowed with a cold green light. They rushed towards Hu Jiulang from three directions at the same time with an indomitable murderous intention.

The three of them are all top masters of the Koga School. They are proficient in ninjutsu, escape techniques, poison techniques, and close combat. A joint attack can tear apart the protective barrier of ordinary monks, and their power is terrifying.

The wind in the forest suddenly stopped, and the air seemed to be frozen with murderous intent. The other ninjas retreated one after another to free up space on the battlefield, waiting for the three jounin to kill the opponent's leader.

"Senior Brother Hu, be careful!" Fan Mengxue's eyes narrowed, and she was about to urge Lei Fa to come forward to support.

"No need." Hu Jiulang raised his hand to signal her to stay in the formation, facing the three jounin alone, his figure as tall as a pine, standing in the center of the Bagua formation.

His left hand is behind his back, and the fingertips of his right hand are holding the Suppression Seal. The golden hexagram patterns are flowing around his body, and the innate power of the eight hexagrams is ready to go.

Three black shadows approached in an instant, and the short blades carried sharp winds that broke through the air, striking at Hu Jiulang's three vital points between his eyebrows, his heart, and his waist. Their moves were vicious, tricky, and fatal.

The moment the short blade was about to approach——

The golden Bagua pattern on the ground suddenly surged, turning into a circular golden barrier, firmly protecting Hu Jiulang's whole body.

clang!clang!clang!

Three harsh sounds of gold and iron sounded one after another.

The poison-quenched short blades of the three Jonin struck hard on the golden light barrier, causing air waves to roll and dust to rise, but they could not break through the Bagua barrier's defense at all. Instead, they were shocked so hard that their arms went numb and they involuntarily took a few steps back.

The three people's eyes were all shocked.

Unexpectedly, this young Taoist priest's formation skills were so powerful that he was able to carry the three of them together and attack with only the formation, without moving at all.

"If you can't break through a strong attack, use trickery instead!"

A jounin shouted, and the three people's bodies suddenly differentiated and turned into countless clones and phantoms. It was difficult to distinguish the true from the false. They used the afterimages to confuse the vision and once again attacked from all directions, specializing in the flaw in the barrier.

"Little tricks."

Hu Jiulang's eyes were cold, and under his direct gaze, all the clones and phantoms were invisible, and the three people's true auras were clearly reflected in his eyes.

With a slight twist of his fingertips, the three cinnabar talismans suspended in the air instantly ignited with fire and turned into three red light bands, which accurately locked onto the bodies of the three Jonin, ignoring the interference of the clones, and struck directly between the eyebrows.
